captions.text: 1946, year 1 of the new era
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The next day he returned as the previous times, and he spoke.
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The time of the end of the world has come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Not of the end of the world in a catastrophe destroying the Earth, but of the end of the world of the Church, which has done its work, more or less well, but which has done it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A work of popularization allowing the creators to be recognized when they come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As you have noticed, the Christian Church is dying.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the end of that world, for it has fulfilled its mission, with quite a few errors, by wanting too long to deify the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That was good until the scientific civilization, when a change of course should have been made if the true truth had been kept and if they had known how to read between the lines.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But they made too many errors.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That was foreseen, and they will collapse, no longer serving any purpose.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Already, gloom gnaws at the people of the scientifically developed countries, who no longer believe in anything.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They can no longer believe in the white-bearded good lord perched on a cloud and omnipresent that they were made to believe in, any more than in the charming little guardian angels or the devil with horns and hooves…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So they no longer know what to believe.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Only certain young people have understood that love was primordial…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You have reached the golden age.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You, the men of Earth, you fly in the heavens, you carry your voice to the four corners of the Earth by radio waves; the times have come for the truth to be revealed to you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As it was written, everything comes to pass now that the Earth has entered under the sign of Aquarius.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Certain men have already written it, but they were not believed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the twenty-two thousand years since the creators decided to do their work on Earth, everything is foreseen, for the movement of the galaxy presupposes this knowledge.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Pisces was the Christ and his fishermen, and Aquarius, which follows, has been here since 1946, the time when the people of Israel recover their country:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There shall be in that day a loud clamor from the side of the
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Fish Gate.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Fish Gate is the passage into the new era of Aquarius.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The moment when the sun rises over the Earth, on the day of the spring equinox, in Aquarius.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The loud clamor is the noise that this revelation will make.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And if you were born in 1946, it is not by chance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The end of the Church
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: This revelation will give back hope and happiness to the gloomy thanks to the light it brings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But it will also hasten the fall of the Church, unless it understands its error and puts itself in the service of the truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the tyrant shall come to his end, the mocker shall vanish, and all those who watch for iniquity shall be cut off:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those who by their declaration make a man a culprit, lay snares for him that renders the judgment at the Gate, and wrongfully turn aside the just.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is the end of those who make people believe in original sin and make a man a culprit, of those who lay snares for him who will spread the truth at the moment of the Gate of the fishes, the entry into Aquarius, in order to try to save the Church as it existed by turning aside the just, he who says what is just, he who says or writes the truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Like those who, persuaded that they were defending something true without seeking to understand, crucified Jesus for fear of seeing themselves ruined and annihilated at the moment of the passage into the era of Pisces.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The eyes of those who see shall no longer be glued shut, and the ears of those who hear shall be attentive.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The fool shall no longer be called noble, and the rogue shall no longer be said to be great.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For the fool utters folly and his heart broods on iniquity, so that he practices impiety, utters toward
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yahweh aberrant words, leaves empty the soul of him who is hungry, and lets him who is thirsty lack drink.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for the rogue, his roguery is criminal; it is he who devises plans to annihilate the poor with lying words, while the needy states his cause.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But he who is noble devises noble acts; it is he who will rise up for noble acts.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Everyone then will understand, the eyes shall no longer be glued shut.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Church, which utters toward Yahweh aberrant words and leaves empty the soul of those who hunger for truth, it is she who devises plans to annihilate the poor, to bring it about that those who cannot understand, or do not dare to understand, remain faithful to her, in the fear of sin, of excommunication, or other nonsense.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: While the needy states his cause, while he who has not enough intelligence to grasp the truth stands up as a defender of the lies of the Church on its advice.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But he who is noble, he who will clamor the truth loud and clear, devises noble acts, even if he does not have the assent of the dying Church of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do you not know, have you not heard, has it not been declared to you from the beginning?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Have you not understood the foundation of the earth?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Behold my servant whom I uphold, my elect in whom my soul delights.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I have put my spirit upon him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He shall make known to the nations a judgment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are the one who is going to spread the truth throughout the world, this truth which has been revealed to you for a few days.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He shall not break the bent reed, and shall not quench the wick that grows faint.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You will not succeed in completely destroying the Church and its lies, but it will go out by itself.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This extinction is, moreover, already begun for some time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The wick grows faint.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It has accomplished its mission; it is the hour for it to disappear.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It has made errors and has enriched itself too much on the back of the truth without seeking to interpret it in a way clear to the men of this era, but do not blame it too much, for it is thanks to it that the Bible, witness of the truth, can be found throughout the whole world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: However, their errors are great, particularly that of having put too much of the supernatural into the truth, of having badly translated the biblical writings by replacing in the usual Bibles the term Elohim, which designates the creators, with God, a term in the singular, whereas Elohim, in Hebrew, is the plural of Eloha, thus transforming the creators into a single incomprehensible God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The other errors are to have made people worship a piece of wood put in a cross in memory of Jesus Christ.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A cross is not the Christ.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A crossed piece of wood signifies nothing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He does not reconsider in his heart; he has neither knowledge nor intelligence to say, I have burned half of it in the fire; I have also baked bread on its coals; I roast meat and eat it, and I shall make of the rest an abomination!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I shall worship a piece of wood!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creation of the State of Israel
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The return to Israel of the Jewish people is a sign of the golden age that was written: I will bring your race from the east and from the west; I will gather you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I will say to the North: give! and to the South: do not hold back; bring my sons from afar and my daughters from the end of the earth, all those who are called by my name, those whom I have, for my glory, created, formed and made!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is indeed the creation of the State of Israel welcoming the Jews of the North and of the South.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the fact that the Bible, preserved by the Jewish people, serves as testimony to the coming of the creators is written:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are my witnesses!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Bring forth the blind people who yet have eyes, the deaf who nevertheless have ears.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Let all the nations be gathered together, let the peoples assemble!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Who among them has predicted these things and made us hear the announcement of the first events?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Let them produce their witnesses to be justified, let it be heard and let it be said: it is true!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are my witnesses! oracle of Yahweh, and you are my servant whom I have chosen, that you may know, that you may believe in me and that you may understand that I am the same.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As for you, you are my witnesses, oracle of Yahweh, and I am God: today also I am the same.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are my witnesses, it is explicit, is it not?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And I can say to you again on this day: today I am the same, thanks to the testimony you have in hand with the Bible.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I had forsaken you for a brief instant, but I will gather you with a great compassion.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The people of Israel have indeed recovered their country after having participated in the safeguarding of the truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The times when man, through science, will master illness are foreseen:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There shall no longer be there an infant living a few days, nor an old man who does not accomplish his days.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Medicine now allows men to triumph over illness and especially over infant mortality.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the lips of the intelligent man is found wisdom, but the rod is for the back of him who is deprived of heart.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The errors of the Church
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The Church, yes, has sinned by making man feel guilty and by making him pray without his seeking to understand.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In your prayers, do not babble like the pagans.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They believe that with their wordiness they will be heard.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Despite the warning of the Gospels, the Church has also enriched itself too much, whereas it was written:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: No one can be enslaved to two lords: for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will cleave to the one and despise the other.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You cannot be enslaved to God and to Mammon.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon the earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Possess neither gold nor silver nor money in your belts; no scrips for the way, nor a second tunic, nor sandals, nor a staff.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: With their stupid rules and their meatless Fridays, they have not respected their own gospel:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not what enters the mouth that defiles the man: but what comes out of the mouth, that is what defiles the man.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How do they dare, these men who are only men, to lounge in the fortune and luxury of the Vatican, when their gospels tell them to possess neither gold nor silver, not even a second tunic — how do they dare to preach goodness?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And Jesus said to his disciples: yes I say to you, a rich man enters with difficulty into the kingdom of the heavens.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They bind heavy burdens and lay them on the shoulders of men, but they themselves will not move them with a finger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All their works they do to be noticed by men they love the first place at dinners and to be saluted.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You others you have but one master and you are all brothers.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And call no one of you father on the earth, for you have but one father, the heavenly one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not have yourselves called director either, for you have but one director, the Christ.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the greatest among you shall be your servant.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is, however, written in their gospels.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How does the Church dare to overwhelm men with so-called sins which are only different conceptions of mores and ways of life, to speak of goodness while living in the opulence of the Vatican when men die of hunger, to have itself invited and seek honors while preaching humility, to have itself called my father, eminence, or your holiness when their own gospels forbid it to them!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If tomorrow the pope set out on the roads with his scrip, the Church would live again.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But with a humanitarian aim entirely different from the one that was its own until now: namely the propagation of what must serve as proof today.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This mission is ended, but the Church can reconvert itself onto the path of goodness, of help to the unhappy peoples, of help to the propagation of the true face of the writings deformed or kept secret until now.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The greatness of soul of certain of the men of the Church would thus find its accomplishment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For that, the Vatican must set the example by selling all its riches for the benefit of the underdeveloped nations and by going there to help men to progress, by offering its hands to work and no longer the good word.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is inadmissible that there be different categories of marriages and especially of burials according to the fortune of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yet another error of the Church.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the times have come!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At the origin of all the religions
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: Traces of the truth — there are not only in the Bible and the Gospels; testimonies are found in practically all the religions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Kabbalah notably is one of the books richest in testimonies, but it would not have been easy for you to procure one.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If one day you can find a copy, you will be able to observe in it a very great number of allusions to us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In particular a description in the Song of Songs (V) of the planet of the creators as well as the distance that separates it from the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is said there that the height of the creator is 236,000 parasangs and that the height of his heels is 30 million parasangs.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The parasang, which, like the parsec, is a unit of measure, equals the distance that light travels in one second, that is, about 300,000 kilometers.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Our planet is at 30 million parasangs, that is, about nine thousand billion kilometers, or a little less than a light-year.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: By moving at the speed of light, that is, 300,000 km/second, you would take almost a year to reach our planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: With your current rockets, which move only at 40,000 km/h, you would take nearly 26,000 years before arriving up to us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You see that we have nothing to fear for the moment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have the means to travel from our planet to the Earth in less than two months thanks to a mode of propulsion using the atom and allowing us to move at the speed of rays that are seven times faster than light.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These rays carry us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So that we may be carried by them, we leave the optical window, the range of rays that the eyes perceive, to attune ourselves with the carrier radiation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is why terrestrial observers of our flying craft have described them as becoming luminous, very bright white, then blue, and finally disappearing.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is evident that when a craft exceeds the speed of light, it disappears; it is no longer visible to the naked eye.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is the height of the heels of the creator, the distance at which his heels rest on a planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The planet of the creators is distant from its sun by 236,000 parasangs, that is, 70 billion eight hundred million kilometers; that is the height of the creator, in relation to its sun, a big star.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Kabbalah is the book closest to the truth, but almost all the religious books allude to us more or less clearly, especially in the countries where the creators had bases: in the cordillera of the Andes, in the Himalayas, in Greece where Mythology also contains great testimonies, the Buddhist religion, the Islamic, the Mormons — it would take pages to cite all the religions and sects that testify in a more or less obscure way to our work.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man: a disease of the universe
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: There, you now know the truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It must be written and made known throughout the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the men of Earth want us to make them benefit from our knowledge, thus making them gain 25,000 years, they must show us that they have a desire to meet us and especially that they deserve it, that it can be done without danger to us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If we give men our knowledge, we must be sure that they will make good use of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Our observations of these last years have not shown us that wisdom reigned on Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Certainly, there is progress, but men still die of hunger and the bellicose spirit still exists throughout the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We know that our coming could arrange many things and unite the nations, but we must feel that men truly desire it and that they really sketch out the union.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We must, on the other hand, feel that there is truly a desire to see us come with full knowledge of the cause.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Several times human craft with a warlike vocation have tried to give chase to our apparatuses, taking them, it is true, for enemies.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We must teach them who we are so that we may dare to show ourselves without risking being wounded or killed, which is not the case at present, and without risking either creating a deadly and dangerous panic.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Certain researchers want to contact us by radio, but we do not want, in answering, for them to be able to locate our planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the other hand, the transmission time would be too long, and our emission apparatuses use waves that your technique cannot perceive, for you do not yet know them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They are seven times faster than radioelectric waves, and we are experimenting with new waves one and a half times faster than these latter.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Progress continues, and our own research pursues itself with the aim of understanding and entering into relation with the great being of which we are all a part and of which we are the parasites of the atoms, these atoms being the planets and the stars.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have indeed been able to discover that in the infinitely small, intelligent living beings live on particles that are for them planets and suns, asking themselves the same questions as we do.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man is a disease of the gigantic being of which the planets and the stars are atoms.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And this being is surely itself also a parasite of other atoms.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In both directions, it is infinite.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the important thing is to bring it about that our disease, humanity, continues to exist and never goes out.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We did not know, in creating you, that we were accomplishing a secondary mission, written in us, thus repeating what had been done for us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We have discovered, in the light of our creation and of its evolution, our own origins.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For we too were created by other men who have today disappeared, their world has certainly disintegrated, but thanks to them, we were able to take over and create you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We will perhaps disappear one day, but you will have taken over.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You are therefore the link of a precious human continuity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Other worlds exist, and humanity is certainly developing at other points of the universe.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But in this part, our world is the only one to have created, and that is important, for from each world there can come innumerable children precious for the continuity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That lets us hope that one day, man will no longer be in danger of total disappearance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But we are not sure that man can ever stabilize himself in abundance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Since always the chain continues, and the very balance of the immense body of which we are a disease, a parasite, requires that we not develop too much, under penalty of bringing about a reaction that could lead to a catastrophe resulting at best in a recession, at worst in a total destruction.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: As in a healthy body, a few microbes can live without fear, but if they develop in too great a number, they create a disease bothering the organism, which then reacts either naturally or with the aid of medicines charged with destroying the responsible microbes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The important thing is apparently to create enough worlds so that humanity does not go out, but especially to seek that the balance not be broken, by carrying our efforts onto a search for the improvement of the happiness of those who exist.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is on this plane that we can bring you much.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Evolution: a myth
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: I open here a parenthesis, for you must be able to dispel from your mind the doubt of evolution.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Your scientists, who established the theories of evolution, are not completely mistaken in saying that man descends from the monkey and the monkey from the fish, etc…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In reality the first living organism created on Earth was indeed monocellular and then gave rise to more complicated beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But not by chance!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When we came to create life on the earth, we began with very simple creations, and we made our techniques of adaptation to the environment progress in order then to make the fish, the batrachians, the mammals, the birds, the primates, and finally man, who is only a model of improved monkey, to which we added what made us be men; we made him in our image as it is written in the biblical Genesis.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You could realize for yourselves that an accidental evolution has very little chance of occurring so as to arrive at such a great variety of forms of life, at the colors of the birds, at their amorous demonstrations, at the form of the horns of certain antelopes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: What natural need could then bring the antelopes or certain ibexes to have spiral horns? or the birds to have blue, or red, feathers, and the exotic fish?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is the work of our artists.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Do not forget the artists when you create, in your turn, life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Imagine a world where they would not exist, without music, nor films, nor paintings, nor sculptures, etc…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Life would be quite boring and the animals quite ugly if they had to have a body answering only to their needs or their functions.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The evolution of the forms of life on Earth is the evolution of the techniques of creation and the sophistication of the works realized by the creators in order finally to arrive at the creation of a being similar to them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You can find skulls of prehistoric men, which are the skulls of the first prototypes of man that were supplanted by others more evolved, up to the type being the exact replica of the creators, who were afraid to create a being that would be much superior to them, although certain ones had the temptation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If one were sure that they would never turn against their creators to dominate or annihilate them, as happened among the various hominian races created successively on Earth, instead of loving them like fathers, the temptation would be great to improve the human kind.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is possible, but what an enormous risk!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Certain creators are, moreover, afraid that the man of Earth may be slightly superior to his fathers; Satan is one of those who has always thought and still thinks that the man of Earth is a danger for our planet because a little too intelligent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But the majority of us thinks that you will prove to us that you love us and that you will never seek to destroy us.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That is at least what we await in order to come to your aid.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is, moreover, possible that, at each creation of man by man, a slight improvement, a veritable evolution of the human race, but gentle so that the creator does not feel in danger faced with the created, may be realized, allowing progress to be made more and more rapidly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If we do not yet think that we can give you our scientific baggage, we think that we can give you without danger our political and humanitarian baggage.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If this latter does not allow you to threaten your planet, it will allow you to be happier on Earth, and, thanks to happiness, to progress faster.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: That will be able to help you show us more rapidly that you deserve our help, our inheritance, in order to attain an intergalactic level of civilization.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Otherwise, if the aggressiveness of men does not calm down, if peace does not become their only goal and they allow people who encourage war, by favoring the manufacture of weapons, the warlike atomic experiments, or by allowing the armies to continue to exist, to remain in power or to take it, we will prevent them from becoming a danger for us, and it will be a new Sodom and Gomorrah.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: How could we fear nothing from the men of Earth when they attack their fellows, we who are from another world and slightly different?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You, Claude Vorilhon, you will spread the truth under your present name, which you will progressively replace with the name that you bear for us, RAËL.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Which means literally light of God, and if one makes a more precise translation, light of the Elohim, or more exactly he who brings the light of the Elohim, or Ambassador of the Elohim, for you will indeed be our ambassador on the Earth, and we will officially land only in your embassy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: RAËL can be translated more simply as messenger.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is, moreover, by telepathy that we had you name your Son Ramuel, which means the son of him who brings the light, for he is indeed the son of our messenger, of our ambassador.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And he departed as the other mornings.
captions.speaker: Narrator
